treatment.logline: Inside a rain-bound cash van, a personal message and a work directive compete for Dinu's attention; a glance at his wrist precedes an unexplained change of course.

arc.beat: Work enclosed by the wet city; the dashboard photograph opens a private association.
The recorded message lands, then an incoming connection displaces it.
A new destination is imposed; Dinu looks at his thread and complies.
arc.feeling: Pressure held inside an unreadable choice.

treatment.approach: A ninety-second raw-material reference built from confined handheld masters, listening singles and necessary prop details. Coverage length belongs to the held reactions and alternate perspectives on the same events, not invented business or repeated dialogue in the reference assembly. Restrained vehicle vibration, no decorative moves, no music.

treatment.geography: Keep every camera inside the van. Dinu stays seated at the right-hand driving position, looking toward the road; dashboard and windshield remain ahead of him. His right hand controls the wheel with the red thread on that wrist; his left palm supports the phone low over his lap throughout. The faded photograph stays on the dashboard. Reverse coverage never crosses the driver-to-windshield axis.
treatment.key_image: Dinu's threaded wrist remains on the wheel while the wet city's reflections move beyond it.
advice: Establish the photograph before L3; its two small faded figures must not become live portraits.
Use L3 once and L5 once in the reference assembly; their additional picture coverage provides replaceable listening angles.
Hold the thread glance before the turn, without implying why the thread matters.
No exterior arrival, added destination signage, phone-button choreography or explanatory gesture.

moments.cut_uses: Six-second listening single carries L5, followed by an eight-second contained reaction master; do not duplicate the line.

moments.what: Dinu looks at his wrist thread, then steers toward the industrial area.
moments.feeling: An observable decision with its reason withheld.
moments.cut_uses: Wrist-and-eyeline close single establishes the glance; a driver close single supplies its matching performance; an interior master shows the subsequent turn; a final driver single holds the new heading. The first two are matching coverage, not two separate glances.

editor_notes: The bin contains 14 must takes, 90 seconds total. Takes include handles and alternate picture, so 90 seconds of source is not a guarantee of a 90-second finished assembly; do not repeat an event or dialogue merely to stretch the runtime.

Use the passenger-side masters for geography, the close singles for contained listening, the held reactions for the turns, and the dashboard and phone details for the explicitly required photograph and source change.

L3 is a single complete 6.4-second recorded message; c05 and c06 are matching full-length picture alternatives. L5 is one complete 4.1-second phone line on c09. Both voices remain offscreen and Dinu's lips stay closed.

All generated clips are marked silent to prevent invented speech. Build rain, engine, road wash, incoming tone and the two authorized voice tracks in post; distinguish recorded playback from live phone audio by texture. No music is prescribed.

c11 and c12 cover the same thread glance, not two glances; match eye direction and the stationary right hand. Follow with the turn in c13, then the new-heading hold in c14. Avoid a false match that reverses wheel movement or transfers the phone.

The right-hand driving position, right-wrist thread, phone resting in the left palm and plain dark work shirt are continuity choices where the packet is not more specific; keep them consistent. The photograph remains on the dashboard.
The caller ID is a screen graphic; replace or composite it in post if the generated text is unreliable. Keep the photograph as a worn static image with tiny figures, not live portraits.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options, not generated camera moves; none is required here. Do not use slow motion in this scene. The held frames are clean sources if post elects a restrained punch-in.
Avoid mirror shots, elaborate finger work, body contact and precise generated screen lettering. Do not show an arrival or add a reason for the thread glance.

editor_notes: The bin contains 14 must takes, 90 seconds total. Takes include handles and alternate picture, so 90 seconds of source is not a guarantee of a 90-second finished assembly; do not repeat an event or dialogue merely to stretch the runtime.

Use the passenger-side masters for geography, the close singles for contained listening, the held reactions for the turns, and the dashboard and phone details for the explicitly required photograph and source change.

L3 is a single complete 6.4-second recorded message; c05 and c06 are matching full-length picture alternatives. L5 is one complete 4.1-second phone line on c09. Both voices remain offscreen and Dinu's lips stay closed.

All generated clips are marked silent to prevent invented speech. Build rain, engine, road wash, incoming tone and the two authorized voice tracks in post; distinguish recorded playback from live phone audio by texture. No music is prescribed.

c11 and c12 cover the same thread glance, not two glances; match eye direction and the stationary right hand. Follow with the turn in c13, then the new-heading hold in c14. Avoid a false match that reverses wheel movement or transfers the phone.

The right-hand driving position, right-wrist thread, phone resting in the left palm and plain dark work shirt are continuity choices where the packet is not more specific; keep them consistent. The photograph remains on the dashboard.
The caller ID is a screen graphic; replace or composite it in post if the generated text is unreliable. Keep the photograph as a worn static image with tiny figures, not live portraits.

Speed ramp, freeze frame, digital punch-in and split screen are post-only options, not generated camera moves; none is required here. Do not use slow motion in this scene. The held frames are clean sources if post elects a restrained punch-in.
Avoid mirror shots, elaborate finger work, body contact and precise generated screen lettering. Do not show an arrival or add a reason for the thread glance.

c16: Close moment 7 after the turn in c13, alongside the final heading hold in c14; carry the existing engine and rain bed, without dialogue.
c17: Use as replacement picture within moment 4 over Aruni's recorded L3 from c05 or c06; retain the recording texture and do not repeat the line.
c18: Use as replacement picture within moment 6 over Mudalali's L5 from c09, then hold on the existing cab bed before the wrist glance; do not repeat the line.
c19: Open moment 1 before c01 with the enclosed engine and rain bed; no dialogue or music.

review.why: The interior windshield view establishes the enclosed wet journey before the driver coverage.
The locked dashboard photograph insert already makes the required shared past legible; another detail would duplicate it.
The locked driver single and recorded playback already establish the private audio entering the cab without extra business.
An isolated eye reaction holds the recorded message's emotional landing without repeating the dialogue.
The locked phone insert already makes the incoming connection and caller ID readable.
A held low-angle face reaction gives the directive a distinct, restrained landing over the existing line.
The wrist insert isolates the decision's physical hinge, and an interior windshield view holds the resulting industrial heading.
